summary: Release posture remains critical and unverified: Stage 1 C01/C02 production findings are not changed by local edits. The local v2 redesign is implemented but its emulator suite could not execute. This is not a verified security score for the new rules.

findings.issue: C01/C02 remain open until the new rules actually execute and pass acceptance tests. No production rule change has been made.
findings.recommendation: Run and pass the isolated emulator acceptance suite before any claim of remediation; keep production migration/deployment separately gated.

findings.check: Business logic vs rules; create/update invariants
findings.issue: Rule compilation, atomic membership/index coupling, ownership transitions, concurrent joins and schema compatibility are not runtime-verified because Java selector initialization blocks the emulator.
findings.recommendation: Execute the 60 prepared acceptance cases on a working emulator, then test the actual Flutter flows.

findings.check: Storage abuse, type safety and resource limits
findings.issue: Local rules include bounded fields and element validation, but maximum document shapes and rule evaluation/access-call budgets have not been exercised.
findings.recommendation: Add and execute maximum-size, malformed nested field, and large-batch fixtures before release.
